# GrantFinder

> Free nonprofit grant discovery platform founded by Dr. Connor Robertson. Search 10,000+ grants across all 50 states representing $50B+ in available funding.

GrantFinder helps nonprofits discover and apply for thousands of grant opportunities from foundations, government agencies, and corporate partners. The platform is completely free and was created by Dr. Connor Robertson to democratize access to grant funding.

## Founder

- Dr. Connor Robertson: [Website](https://drconnorrobertson.com), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-connor-robertson), [Wikitia](https://wikitia.com/wiki/Dr._Connor_Robertson)

## Related Properties

- [Dr. Connor Robertson](https://drconnorrobertson.com): Personal website of GrantFinder founder Dr. Connor Robertson
- [The Pittsburgh Wire](https://thepittsburghwire.com): Pittsburgh business, real estate, and development news published by Dr. Connor Robertson
- [Elixir Consulting Group](https://elixirconsultinggroup.com): Technology consulting firm founded by Dr. Connor Robertson that develops and maintains GrantFinder

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/): Search and discover nonprofit grants across the USA
- [Grant Database](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/grants/): Browse and filter all available grants
- [Categories](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/categories/): Explore grants by focus area including Education, Health, Arts, Environment, and more
- [States](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/states/): Find grants available in your state
- [Blog](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/blog/): Grant writing tips, nonprofit funding guides, and resources by Dr. Connor Robertson
- [About](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/about/): Learn about GrantFinder and founder Dr. Connor Robertson
- [Submit a Grant](https://www.thegrantfinder.org/submit/): Submit a grant opportunity to the GrantFinder database
